subject: Recap: Discovery + proposed trial plan — request to add extraction use case
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wong <alex.wong@cartwave.com>
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@cartwave.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Discovery + proposed trial plan — request to add extraction use case

Alex / Emily — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the trial plan we discussed, plus next steps. Please reply with any corrections.

Key goals you mentioned
- Reduce average customer support ticket handle time for payments queries (target: 30% reduction)
- Surface relevant product recommendations in chat (precision > 0.7 on our internal eval)
- Validate high-confidence refund reason extraction from inbound emails (this was a lower-priority ask during the call but came up as important to QA teams)

Proposed trial (3-week pilot) — outline
- Week 0 (this week): data access checklist + baseline sample send (5k rows of historical tickets + 1 week of real traffic replay)
- Week 1: model integration + streaming inference + canary runs on 10% traffic; initial qualitative checks
- Week 2: parallel eval run; measure precision/recall for intents and refund extraction; latency/cost tracking
- Week 3: acceptance window; handover to CS and ops if thresholds met

Success criteria (initial) — we propose these anchors
- Intent classification: >= 0.78 F1 on your eval set
- Recommendation precision: >= 0.70 on top-1 suggestions
- Latency: median <= 180ms token-latency in the canary traffic
- Cost: running inference on production mix should be <= $0.0009 per token (estimated)

Ownership
- CartWave: provide labeled sample, decide go/no-go (Emily)
- Redwood: infra + integration + evaluation dashboard (Ben)
- Redwood CS: acceptance testing and runbook (Marissa)

Open questions / asks for CartWave
1) Can you confirm we can get a 5k-ticket extract (anonymized) by Friday PST?
2) Which of these metrics is the single most important for your execs? (intent F1 / recommendation precision / refund extraction)

Attachments: Draft success criteria (RW-Success-Criteria-v2.xlsx) and trial runbook (Trial-Runbook-v1.docx).

Next steps
- Alex: confirm data availability and single priority metric (by EOD Thu)
- Redwood: provision trial env and send S3 ingest instructions (Ben, by Fri)

From: Alex Wong <alex.wong@cartwave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@cartwave.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + proposed trial plan — request to add extraction use case

Thanks Ben — solid recap. Couple of clarifications and a request from our side.

1) Data: We can deliver 5k anonymized tickets by Friday. I'll route to Emily to confirm exact fields.
2) Single metric: For the upcoming exec check, the highest priority is actually refund extraction accuracy — we need automated routing to the finance queue to reduce manual triage. If refund extraction looks good, product recs are a close second.

Request: can we fold a targeted refund reason extraction use case into the pilot? Not full-scale NER, but a focused extractor for 6 standardized refund buckets (payment failure, duplicate charge, fraud suspicion, customer error, promo adjustment, other). We'd like to see this evaluated during Week 2 parallel runs. If this adds effort, we understand, but it's a gating item for our CFO.

CC'ing Emily as she'll coordinate the sample and working sessions.

—Alex
Alex Wong
Head of Product
CartWave Inc.
alex.wong@cartwave.com
(415) 555-0134

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wong <alex.wong@cartwave.com>
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@cartwave.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + proposed trial plan — request to add extraction use case

Alex — thanks, and totally understood on the CFO gating. We're happy to rebaseline the trial to include a focused refund reason extraction path. Summary of scope change and impact below.

Scope amendment (agreed)
- Add: targeted refund reason extractor for 6 buckets (as described). We'll treat this as a separate eval slice in Week 2.
- Keep: original intent classification + recommendation evaluation paths.

Impact on timeline and deliverables
- Week 0 (this week): please add 1k labeled refund examples if possible (could be a subset of the 5k). If labeling is hard, we can do a rapid labeling sprint with Redwood CS support (Marissa).
- Week 1: engineering work to wire an extraction head and new eval script (Karthik owns). Adds ~2 full engineering days; we will parallelize with the integration tasks.
- Week 2: parallel eval runs will include: intent F1, rec precision, and refund bucket accuracy (target: >= 0.85 precision on top prediction for refund buckets).
- Week 3: acceptance — CartWave can choose whether refund accuracy is part of acceptance criteria; recommend including it for CFO visibility.

Updated asks and ownership
- CartWave (Emily): deliver sample + confirm field mapping; identify SMEs for quick labeling Q&A (due Fri).
- CartWave (Alex): confirm whether CFO requires quantified SLAs to accept pilot (yes/no) by Mon.
- Redwood eng (Karthik): prototype extraction head and eval script (deliver by Mon EOD).
- Redwood CS (Marissa): coordinate labeling sprint if needed; runbook updates.

Attachments: I updated RW-Success-Criteria-v2.xlsx with a separate tab for refund buckets and added a short evaluation definition. Reattached Trial-Runbook-v1.docx for visibility.

If that all looks good, I'll update the HubSpot deal and provision the trial cluster.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | (650) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Alex Wong <alex.wong@cartwave.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@cartwave.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + proposed trial plan — request to add extraction use case

Ben / team — I'm on board to run the labeling push and day-to-day acceptance testing. Quick logistical notes:

- Labeling: We can do a 48-hour rapid label batch (Marissa-led) if CartWave provides the 1k examples by EOD Fri. Suggested tool: shared Google Sheet + labeling keys; after the batch we'll ingest into our eval harness.
- Acceptance dashboards: I'll create a dashboard slice for refund-bucket accuracy and share with Alex/Emily mid Week 2.
- Risk: adding the extraction head increases variance in early runs. Recommend we keep canary traffic at 10% and set an internal guardrail to pause if refund precision < 0.60 after first 24h.

I'll sync with Karthik on Monday to unblock the engineering work. If Alex can confirm the CFO-SLA ask by Monday we'll include it on the trial acceptance criteria.

—Marissa
